ctx.x: Well, he had been the trombone player in the Jim Europe band, and he and W.C. Handy had been great friends. And I remember when I got out of high school and got my little piece of paper, I thought... You know, I had studied composition and arranging and copying music; I thought I could get a job as a copyist. So he gave me a note to meet Mr. Handy; I think he was at 1619 Broadway in New York.
